title: Description: This issue affects NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source configurations that use HTTP/3. (CVE-2026-121810)
description: CVE-2026-121810 affects NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source configurations using HTTP/3. It allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause a use-after-free condition in the NGINX worker process, potentially leading to a denial-of-service (DoS) or code execution on systems with ASLR disabled or bypassed. This vulnerability impacts the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. Exploitation depends on conditions beyond the attacker's control. No affected versions or patch information are provided.
